issue_title: [Bug] to_dict() 返回类型缺少泛型注解，与 from_dict 类型签名不一致
fix_summary: Added proper generic type annotations to to_dict() and from_dict() methods in Todo class. Changed from bare 'dict' to 'dict[str, int | str | bool]' for both methods to ensure type signature consistency.
acceptance_criteria_met: to_dict() return type annotation explicitly includes dict[str, int | str | bool]
risks: None - this is a pure type annotation change with no runtime behavior modification
